svg.title: Sync correlator bank with stock blocks
svg.text: Stage 1b — the sync correlator bank (stock blocks only)
What one output sample looks at: 24 samples, one per symbol, ending at n
● = the sample at each symbol centre (every 10th sample) · small dots = the 9 samples in between, ignored
Blue heights = the template t: the 24 sync symbols (±3), made zero-mean and unit-energy. FIR taps = t on a 231-tap comb, time-reversed.
